backend_python_resume.text: Backend developer with 3 years experience. Built REST APIs using FastAPI and Django REST Framework. Strong in PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes. Deployed microservices on AWS. Python, SQL, Git, CI/CD pipelines.

ml_engineer_resume.text: Machine learning engineer with expertise in PyTorch, scikit-learn, NLP, and deep learning. Built recommendation systems and text classification models. Experience with FAISS, sentence-transformers, and HuggingFace transformers. Python, NumPy, pandas, SQL.

data_scientist_resume.text: Data scientist with 4 years experience in analytics and people analytics. Strong in Python, SQL, statistical modeling, A/B testing, and dashboarding. Built predictive models for HR attrition using scikit-learn. Experience with Tableau and stakeholder communication.

frontend_resume.text: Frontend developer with 2 years building React applications. Strong in JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, Tailwind. Built responsive dashboards and component libraries. Experience with REST API integration, Git, and modern build tools.

python_generalist_resume.text: Python developer with 1 year experience building web applications and automation scripts. Familiar with Flask, FastAPI, SQL, and REST APIs. Built small ML projects using scikit-learn. Comfortable with Git, Docker basics, and Linux.
